inputs.description: Absolute path or glob for files to copy to the selected Android target's Download folder
Path or glob on the selected Android target to copy into this machine's Downloads folder
ADB serial from the 'Android Target: List connected' task (for example emulator-5554)

tasks.label: Android Emulator: Cold boot
tasks.detail: Two AVDs are configured on this machine (Pixel_6_Pro, Pixel_10_Pro_XL) — this task targets Pixel_6_Pro, the one with the Lingora dev client installed. Duplicate this task with a different -avd value to boot the other.

tasks.label: Android Emulator: Wait until ready
tasks.command: adb -e wait-for-device shell 'while [[ -z $(getprop sys.boot_completed) ]]; do sleep 1; done; input keyevent 82'

tasks.label: Android Emulator: Stop emulator + Metro + ADB
tasks.command: adb emu kill 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'expo start' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'expo run' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'qemu-system' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'emulator64' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'crashpad_handler' 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:8081 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9; lsof -ti:19000,19001,19002 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9; adb kill-server 2>/dev/null; echo 'Stopped: emulator, Metro/expo, adb server, and anything still bound to the Metro/Expo ports.'

windows.command: adb emu kill 2>$null; Get-Process -Name 'qemu-system-*','emulator*','node' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -match 'expo|qemu|emulator' -or $_.ProcessName -match 'qemu|emulator' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; adb kill-server 2>$null; Write-Host 'Stopped: emulator, Metro/expo, adb server.'

tasks.detail: Stops the emulator process tree, Expo/Metro processes, anything bound to Expo ports, and the ADB server. The next ADB command starts the server again automatically. Safe to run when nothing is active.

tasks.label: Build: Native Android dev client (choose target)
tasks.detail: Builds and installs the native development client. Expo prompts for a target when multiple Android targets are connected. Required after native dependency or plugin changes.

tasks.label: Build: Android preview APK (offline, no Metro)
tasks.detail: Creates an installable EAS preview APK with the JavaScript bundle embedded. The installed app runs without Metro. The first build prompts for Expo login and EAS project/signing setup.

tasks.label: Metro: Reset cache and stop app
tasks.command: pkill -f 'expo start' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'expo run' 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:8081 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9; adb -s "${input:adbTarget}" shell am force-stop com.lingora.mobile; rm -rf apps/mobile/.expo; echo 'Metro cache cleared and app stopped. Start the appropriate Metro task next.'
tasks.detail: Use when the app is stuck or showing a stale bundle. Prompts for the exact ADB target, stops Metro and the app, and clears Expo's local cache. It does not restart Metro.

tasks.label: Android Target: Clear all Lingora app data
tasks.command: adb -s "${input:adbTarget}" shell am force-stop com.lingora.mobile; adb -s "${input:adbTarget}" shell pm clear com.lingora.mobile; echo 'Lingora app data cleared on ${input:adbTarget}: database, SecureStore, settings, and cache were removed.'
tasks.detail: Destructive: prompts for the exact ADB target and wipes all Lingora data without uninstalling the app. Use after migration testing or when a clean application state is required.

tasks.label: Android Target: Relaunch installed app
tasks.command: adb -s "${input:adbTarget}" shell am force-stop com.lingora.mobile; sleep 1; adb -s "${input:adbTarget}" shell monkey -p com.lingora.mobile -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1
tasks.detail: Prompts for the exact ADB target, then force-stops and relaunches its installed Lingora app without rebuilding.

tasks.label: Android Target: List connected
tasks.detail: Plug the phone in via USB first and accept the 'Allow USB debugging?' prompt on the phone, with Developer Options > USB debugging already enabled.

tasks.label: Android Phone: Connect Metro over USB
tasks.detail: Routes the physical phone's localhost:8081 to Metro over USB. Run after connecting the phone and again after reconnecting its USB cable.

tasks.label: Android Target: Push file to Download
tasks.command: matched=0; for f in ${input:hostFilePath}; do if [ -e "$f" ]; then matched=1; echo "Pushing to ${input:adbTarget}: $f"; adb -s "${input:adbTarget}" push "$f" /sdcard/Download/; fi; done; if [ "$matched" -eq 0 ]; then echo "No file matched: ${input:hostFilePath}"; exit 1; fi
tasks.detail: Prompts for an ADB target and a local path or glob, then copies every matching file into that target's Download folder.

tasks.label: Android Target: Pull files from Download
tasks.command: matched=0; for f in $(adb -s "${input:adbTarget}" shell "ls ${input:devicePathOrGlob} 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do matched=1; echo "Pulling from ${input:adbTarget}: $f"; adb -s "${input:adbTarget}" pull "$f" "$HOME/Downloads/"; done; if [ "$matched" -eq 0 ]; then echo "No file matched on ${input:adbTarget}: ${input:devicePathOrGlob}"; exit 1; fi
tasks.detail: Prompts for an ADB target and target-side path or glob, then copies every match into this machine's Downloads folder.

tasks.label: Metro: Start for Android phone over USB
tasks.detail: Starts Metro on localhost without auto-launching an emulator. Run 'Android Phone: Connect Metro over USB', then open the installed development client on the phone.

tasks.label: E2E: Run all Maestro flows
tasks.detail: Runs the complete Maestro UI suite. Boot the Android emulator and start Metro first.

tasks.label: E2E: Run selected Maestro flow
tasks.detail: Prompts for one Maestro flow. Boot the Android emulator and start Metro first.

tasks.label: Android: Print debug keystore SHA-1 / SHA-256
tasks.command: keytool -list -v -keystore apps/mobile/android/app/debug.keystore -alias androiddebugkey -storepass android -keypass android | grep -E 'SHA1:|SHA256:'

windows.command: keytool -list -v -keystore apps\mobile\android\app\debug.keystore -alias androiddebugkey -storepass android -keypass android | Select-String 'SHA1:|SHA256:'

tasks.detail: Reads the fingerprints of the auto-generated Android debug keystore (apps/mobile/android/app/debug.keystore, created by Expo prebuild — run 'Build: Native Android dev client' at least once first if it doesn't exist yet). Add both to the Firebase console (Project settings > your Android app > Add fingerprint) so Google Sign-In works against debug builds. A release build needs the equivalent fingerprints from its own release keystore instead — this task only covers debug.
